text:
emily.hr: Quick question 2D my spouse is finishing COBRA next month and the dentist scheduled a single dental implant (tooth #19) for 6/12. The office says implants are covered but need a pre-authorization + perio/restorative codes. I don't have the new digital ID (COBRA switched carriers) 2D can benefits confirm coverage and get a pre-auth?
tom.benefits: Hi Emily 2D sure. Which carrier was COBRA moved to and what's the plan name? Also need patient DOB, last4 of SSN or member ID, dentist name/address, and an itemized treatment plan with CDT codes (e.g., D6010 for implant).
emily.hr: Carrier: Delta Dental COBRA plan (Redwood COBRA Classic). Spouse: Ana Ruiz / DOB 1988-11-03 / member last4 4321. Provider: BrightSmile Oral Surgery / 410 Market St, SF. CDT: D6010 implant placement, D6100 abutment. Estimate attached: https://files.redwood.example/EST_ANA_0612.pdf
claire.peopleops: Tagging benefits ops 2D if it's accessory to a covered extraction it usually passes, but implants sometimes fall under major services and require separate pre-auth and waiting period checks. Tom 2D any COBRA-specific caveats?
tom.benefits: COBRA maintains same plan benefits but we need to confirm active coverage period ends 6/30 per payroll. Pre-auth SLA for dental major services is 3 business days if we have all docs. I'll open case with Delta Dental and request pre-auth + predetermination letter to give to the clinic.
delta-bot: [auto] Created ticket DDT-55901 for predetermination. Please provide full member ID or SSN last4, X-ray/OPA radiograph, panoramic, and detailed clinical narrative.
emily.hr: Clinic says they have OPG and provider narrative ready. They also asked if assignment of benefits is allowed so they can bill directly under COBRA.
tom.benefits: Most dental carriers allow assignment of benefits for in-network providers; for out-of-network they may or may not. BrightSmile is out-of-network for Delta's PPO in CA. We'll request predetermination and a pre-auth number. If clinic will accept assignment, we can include an AOB form; otherwise member may pay and get reimbursement.
ivan.finance: FYI if member pays upfront and claims reimbursement, finance needs the paid invoice + proof of payment to process any company-administered bridging (if eligible). Keep receipts.
emily.hr: Understood. Clinic said estimate is $3,200 for placement + abutment. Any idea of out-of-pocket after predetermination?
tom.benefits: Depends on CDT mapping and deductibles. Typical allowed amount for D6010 varies; Delta will return an estimated patient responsibility in the predetermination letter. I expect 2025 coinsurance after deductible for major services but will confirm.
delta-bot: [auto] Update: Request DDT-55901 received. Please upload panoramic and perio chart to vendor portal or email claims@delta-dental.com with subject DDT-55901. Expected response 72 business hours.
claire.peopleops: Quick checklist for clinic to speed processing:```
- Include member full name + DOB + full member ID (not just last4)
- Attach panoramic x-ray and narrative
- Use CDT codes D6010 / D6100 and link to prior extraction code if applicable
- Mark request as "predetermination / pre-authorization" and reference DDT-55901
- If accepting AOB, attach signed AOB (US-style)
```
emily.hr: Clinic will upload docs tonight. If Delta denies, can Redwood help with alternative network payment or one-time exception?
tom.benefits: We can escalate to carrier review if predet denies, and for urgent work we occasionally authorize an exception if clinically necessary. Start with predetermination; if denied, ping me and we'll file an appeal.
delta-bot: [auto] Predetermination DDT-55901: provisional approval pending final review. Reference predet number PD-2028-06-0012 in scheduling/claim. Formal letter to follow.
emily.hr: Great 2D clinic confirmed they received PD-2028-06-0012 and will proceed. Thank you all. I'll post the final EOB when claim is processed. :relieved:
claire.peopleops: Thanks Emily 2D please upload EOB & paid receipts (if any) to HRA portal under "dental claims" so casework can reconcile for COBRA closeout records.
tom.benefits: Closing loop: we'll log predetermination and set a reminder to check final claim within 30 days of service. Reopen thread if anything changes.
